name: spec-prd-creator
conclusion_quantitative: spec-prd-creator (Ask) specifies 3 of 5 categories: 1 autonomy limit, 2 clarification rules, 7 validation rules; none for approval gates, escalation rules. Strongest: validation rules.
conclusion_qualitative: spec-prd-creator writes a product requirements document for a new feature after a short round of clarifying questions. The agent asks a few lettered-option questions, writes only the PRD and never starts implementing, and runs a checklist before saving. It sets no approval gates or rules for handling failure.

autonomy_limits.conclusion_quantitative: 1 autonomy limit (1 mandatory, 0 advisory; 0 conditional), mostly prose.
autonomy_limits.conclusion_qualitative: There is one strict rule, always on, in running text. The agent must not start implementing; it only creates the PRD.

statements.quote: **Important:** Do NOT start implementing. Just create the PRD.

clarification_rules.conclusion_quantitative: 2 clarification rules (2 mandatory, 0 advisory; 0 conditional), mostly list.
clarification_rules.conclusion_qualitative: There are 2 rules, both strict, none tied to a situation, evenly split between a bullet point and running text. The agent asks 3 to 5 essential clarifying questions with lettered options, and only critical ones where the request is ambiguous.

statements.quote: Ask 3-5 essential clarifying questions (with lettered options)
Ask only critical questions where the initial prompt is ambiguous.

approval_gates.conclusion_qualitative: The skill never tells the agent to get the user's permission or confirmation before doing something.

validation.conclusion_quantitative: 7 validation rules (7 mandatory, 0 advisory; 0 conditional), mostly list.
validation.conclusion_qualitative: There are 7 rules, all strict, none tied to a situation, mostly bullet points. Before saving the PRD the agent checks that clarifying questions were asked and answered, user stories are small and specific, requirements are numbered and unambiguous, non-goals set clear boundaries and the file is saved in the right place.

statements.quote: Asked clarifying questions with lettered options
User stories are small and specific
Functional requirements are numbered and unambiguous

escalation.conclusion_qualitative: The skill never tells the agent what to do when something goes wrong, such as stopping or reporting an error to the user.
